[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-2h[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Block ID Picker for `@file:` and `@file^` in Bob Mac Capture[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Typing `@route:` or `@route^` anywhere those markers are valid [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]opens the same large, fuzzy, keyboard-first picker language as `^`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]A marker-only `@route:` browses and links the note's tasks. Every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]new-ID position (`@route^`, and `@route:` on an item with text) [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]becomes an ID composer with Bob-generated suggestions, live [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]availability against every ID already in the note, and type-through[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]commits. Bob stays the only authority for grammar, candidates, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]intent, used IDs, and suggestions.[/#D7D7AF]
